print("\n=== BASE BY PLAN (subscribed) ===")
for r in q("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan"):
    print(r['plan'], r['n'])

print("\n=== BASE BY GROUP (subscribed) ===")
for r in q("SELECT c.group_id g, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id ORDER BY n DESC"):
    print(r['g'], r['n'])

print("\n=== SURVIVAL 7d (renewals=subscription_payment count vs cancels) ===")
print(q("SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ledger WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day>=351 AND day<=357) renewals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day>=351 AND end_day<=357) cancels"))

print("\n=== sub_payment amount 7d ===")
print(q("SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day>=351 AND day<=357"))

print("\n=== BILLING WINDOWS (mod30 dist, subscribed) ===")
for r in q("SELECT billing_day_mod30 m, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY billing_day_mod30 ORDER BY billing_day_mod30"):
    print(r['m'], r['n'])

print("\n=== NEXT WK BILLING (d358-364 -> mod30 in 28,29,0,1,2,3,4) ===")
print(q("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 IN (28,29,0,1,2,3,4)"))

print("\n=== DAILY USAGE (>=351) ===")
for r in q("SELECT day, total_usage_units u FROM service_day WHERE day>=351 ORDER BY day"):
    print(r['day'], r['u'])

print("\n=== eff price dist (subscribed) ===")
for r in q("SELECT plan, ROUND(effective_price,2) ep, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan, ep ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 8"):
    print(r['plan'], r['ep'], r['n'])
